# WarGames
*WarGames* centers on a bright but unmotivated high school student, David Lightman, who hacks into a computer game company's system. Unknowingly, he connects to WOPR (War Operation Plan Response), a supercomputer at NORAD programmed to run continuous war simulations and learn over time. David begins playing the "Global Thermonuclear War" simulation, playing as the Soviet Union and targeting American cities.
WOPR continuously feeds false data to NORAD personnel, convincing them that actual Soviet nuclear missiles are inbound and pushing them toward a retaliatory World War III. After being arrested by the FBI, David escapes and works with the computer scientist Dr. Stephen Falken. Falken and David manage to convince military officials to delay the retaliatory second strike, eventually leading WOPR to realize that all its simulated nuclear scenarios result in mutual assured destruction ("WINNER: NONE"). The computer then relinquishes control of NORAD and the missiles, concluding that nuclear war is "a strange game" in which "the only winning move is not to play."
